rec.name: Cart Promo Banner (Quantity Upsell)
rec.status: Built — launched (Focal theme; tested by Chris, KVA approved)

what.text: A configurable promo banner shown under each cart line item in the cart drawer (originally also meant for the cart page). Example copy: "Order 2 and get an extra 10% off!". The banner only appears while the line item quantity is below a configurable threshold. Per comments, clicking it raises the quantity to the threshold and automatically applies a discount code, as in the Hundpur reference. The banner's text, icon, colors, corner style and alignment are all editable.

why.text: It puts a quantity-based incentive right where the buyer is reviewing the item, which encourages multi-unit purchases and raises AOV and units per order. The clear benefit (10% off) works as a discount anchor, and a single click to claim it removes friction. Because it disappears once the threshold is reached, it is not shown to customers who have already qualified.

how.text: 1) Create the snippet cart-promo-banner.liquid. It outputs a div with data-qty and data-line attributes, the icon and the rich text, plus CSS driven by theme settings (flex layout, 13px bold text, 5px padding, optional 4px radius, centered or left alignment, hover background). 2) In the cart drawer section (mini-cart.liquid), render the snippet inside the line item loop only when `line_item.quantity < settings.cart_promo_quantity`. 3) Add a 'Cart Promo Banner' group to settings_schema.json with these settings: quantity, richtext text, html icon, text color, background color, hover background color, border style and text align. 4) Create a quantity-based automatic or code discount in Shopify admin (for example 2+ units gets 10% off). 5) Add JS so that clicking the banner updates the line quantity to the threshold and applies the discount code. This JS is not in the code file and was shown only in a video. The build is Focal-specific, so cart code must be adapted for other themes.

items: Quantity threshold (banner shows while line quantity is below it; default 2)
Text (rich text; default 'Bestelle 2 und erhalte 10% Rabatt extra!')

dependencies.text: Needs no product metafields (MF/N). Requires a Shopify quantity-based discount (automatic or code) set up in admin, since the discount logic lives in Shopify discounts and not in the banner. The cart-drawer click-to-add and apply-discount JS is not in the supplied code, only referenced in comments and a video. The build targets the Focal theme, so other themes need adapted cart code. Settings live in global theme settings rather than a section, and the team asked for a separate 'Cart – Promo Banner' settings entry. A comment also says the banner was once not showing in the cart (resolved via Loom video).
